Frequently asked questions

What is WiFi 7, and how does it improve my home experience?

WiFi 7 is the latest generation of WiFi technology, designed for faster speeds, lower latency, and smoother performance across modern connected homes.

It delivers a more responsive and reliable experience for streaming, gaming, video calls, online learning, and smart home devices — even when multiple devices are connected at the same time.

As more devices become part of your everyday living, WiFi 7 helps keep your home ready for what’s next.

For more details on the WiFi 7 router, click here.

Who can sign up for CelcomDigi Fibre?

Anyone who is 18 years old and above can sign up for CelcomDigi Fibre. Please note that if you are a foreigner, a RM300 deposit will be required.

I'm a CelcomDigi Postpaid customer, do I get to enjoy any offers for fibre? ​

All new and existing customers on CelcomDigi Postpaid plans with a monthly fee of RM60 and above, can enjoy the monthly rebate. 

‍*Any monthly fibre rebates may take up to 60 days to start being reflected in your fibre bill. The monthly rebate is applicable until the 24th month of your contract.

Can I change my Fibre plan or switch from another provider?​

Yes, you can change your CelcomDigi Fibre plan at any time, even during your contract, at no extra charge. Upgrades keep your existing contract, while downgrades start a new 24-month term.

If you are switching from another provider, just reach out to us via WhatsApp and we will be in touch to make arrangements. Alternatively, you can visit the nearest CelcomDigi Store. ​
